discovery_notes: ArtLand 2023-2024 releases found are all DPBStore.com (Disney Pins Blog store) limited editions; retailer DPB Store recorded separately from manufacturer ArtLand. Pulse Gallery is a UK stockist; its prices are listing prices, not launch prices. All claims are search snippets. Multi-pin releases were split into pins only where the post names/describes each pin; Donald's Better Self trio split by per-pin sizes (Donald, Angel, Devil) given in the post. Alice set count 8 derived from three posts (4+2+2).
